description: tonyd2wild's four-Spark vLLM lane for DeepSeek's own DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 checkpoint (FP8 dense with MXFP4 experts, 510 GB, not gated): vLLM dsv41-feat at e47aa780b with the creator's patch set (SM12x attention page sizes, top-k indexer fix, Engram tables read from the checkpoint shards on disk with the speed-run fast staging, 128 read threads, CUDA-graph prestaging), DSpark k=5 speculative decoding with the checkpoint's own draft layers, CUDA graphs (FULL_AND_PIECEWISE), native vision (4 images per prompt), tool calling and the deepseek_v41 reasoning parser, TP4 over the RoCE fabric, 300,000-token context, 8 sequences, 8192 batched tokens, GPU memory 0.80, block size 128, thinking off by default. This is the creator's boot 1017d configuration (NCCL_MAX_NCHANNELS=8, Engram fast staging, 128 Engram threads). Upstream reports (not measured here): 45.3 tok/s at one stream and 157.0 aggregate at six for 1017d; the creator's final 1017g serving config reaches 48.5 and 165.7 with the b12x RoCE all-reduce, which needs a locally built image and mounted files the creator does not publish and is not part of this recipe. Upstream KV pool at 300K: 1,382,505 tokens (1017d), about 81.7 GiB of weights per rank. Memory notes for admission: the Engram n-gram tables (203 GB, shards 47 and 48) are not loaded into memory; the patched loader skips them and reads rows from the mounted shards with preadv (and a read-only memmap on the fast path), so they live in the page cache, not in the vLLM budget; the creator keeps a node-local copy of each rank's rows, which a shared model mount replaces here. The creator drops the page cache before every boot and refuses to start under 100 GiB MemAvailable. Weights are about 81.7 GiB per rank with the draft layers; the declared peak is the 0.80 utilization budget plus the 10.4 GB multi-Spark margin and is an estimate until a hardware try. Licences: MIT (DeepSeek weights, tonyd2wild recipe). The image is drowzeys' published build of the same overlay stack, pinned by digest; it is not the creator's own overlay5 image (built locally, not published), which is still owed. The creator's fleet also answers to a second served name (glm-5.3-flash); only deepseek-v4.1-flash is served here. Needs four Sparks on the 200G RoCE fabric; 510 GB of model files per node.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 native vLLM four Sparks (tonyd2wild)
